capabilities: auto-fold code blocks over a line threshold
expand or collapse folded code by clicking the header
copy code block contents with one click
disambiguation: Not a code editor or syntax tool; it only folds and copies code blocks in rendered notes.
extras: The README notes the plugin uses Obsidian native CSS variables so it works with all themes, and documents compatibility with Obsidian ≥ 0.15.0 on desktop and mobile.
problem: Long code blocks in notes take up a lot of space, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to collapse them.
summary: Code block folding plugin that auto-collapses code blocks longer than a configurable line threshold and adds copy buttons.
